message.content: Helios is currently engrossed in playing "Horizon Forbidden West." He expresses his admiration for the game's stunning world, which he describes as "out of this world." He also praises the gameplay mechanics, calling them "top-notch." Helios's engagement with the game is further emphasized by his anticipation to explore a new section featuring wild new machines, which adds to his immersive experience in the game's diverse environments. This suggests that both the visual and gameplay aspects of "Horizon Forbidden West" are significant factors in his enjoyment and enthusiasm for the game.
